mediaplayer.settings.title: Media player settings
mediaplayer.settings.drag_note: Open chat to move the island with the mouse
mediaplayer.settings.credit: Glass after ReGlass by RedxAx  ·  Mediaplayer by pers1k1
mediaplayer.drag.hint: LMB: move  ·  Wheel: size  ·  RMB: reset
mediaplayer.settings.flag.media.hint: Show the track playing in browsers and players on Windows
mediaplayer.settings.flag.card.hint: Open the island into a big card when a new track starts
mediaplayer.settings.flag.avatar.hint: Your skin head at the left edge of the island
mediaplayer.settings.flag.nick.hint: Your nickname while nothing is playing
mediaplayer.settings.flag.ping.hint: Latency to the server, colored when it gets slow
mediaplayer.settings.flag.statsWithMedia: Keep the FPS and ping capsule under the island while music plays
mediaplayer.settings.flag.cover.hint: Cover of the playing track in place of the head
mediaplayer.settings.flag.coverTint.hint: Visualizer bars take their colors from the cover
mediaplayer.settings.flag.title: Title
mediaplayer.settings.flag.time.hint: Elapsed and total time of the track
mediaplayer.settings.flag.bar.hint: How far the track has played
mediaplayer.settings.flag.visualizer.hin: Bars that dance to the sound of the player
mediaplayer.settings.flag.modFont.hint: Inter, the typeface of BattleCraft. Off: the vanilla Minecraft font
mediaplayer.settings.dial.cardSeconds.hi: How long the card stays open after a track change, from %s to %s seconds
mediaplayer.settings.dial.visualizerGain: How tall the bars get, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
mediaplayer.settings.dial.visualizerSpee: How often the bars follow the sound, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
mediaplayer.settings.dial.visualizerAtta: How fast the bars jump on a beat, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
mediaplayer.settings.dial.visualizerLigh: Brightness of colors taken from the cover, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
mediaplayer.settings.dial.visualizerColo: Saturation of colors taken from the cover, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
mediaplayer.settings.dial.flipSpeed.hint: How fast the cover turns over on a track change, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
